overall: Violation found for adding a topic to the October 23, 2013 agenda less than 48 hours ahead when the chair's agent had anticipated it. Specificity and discussion claims rejected; no further action ordered because the Board took remedial steps.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board amended its October 23, 2013 agenda fewer than 48 hours before the meeting to add a topic it should have anticipated earlier.
allegations.key_passage: Given these facts, we find that the failure to post this agenda item 48 hours in advance was a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the amended agenda item, referring to a complaint filed by a named person, was too vague to inform the public.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the agenda item included in the amended notice for the October 23, 2013 meeting was sufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's discussion under the amended item went beyond the bounds of the posted topic.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find no violation of the Open Meeting Law regarding the substance of the discussion occurring under the amended agenda.
